question: If sqrt{3} tan 2θ − 3 = 0, then find the value of tan θ sec θ − sin θ where 0 < θ < 90°
solution:
**Given:**

√{3} tan2θ − 3 = 0

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc116d26b92d04e13dc77acded25f436fa82e69fd412bed9c969ed5d9be8905b.png] 

**Calculation:**

√{3} tan2θ − 3 = 0

⇒ √{3}tan2θ = 3

⇒ tan2θ = 3/√3

⇒ tan2θ = √3

⇒ tan2θ = tan60°

So, θ = 30°

Now,

tanθsecθ − sinθ = (1/√3) × (2/√3) - (1/2)

⇒ (2/3) - (1/2)

⇒ [(4 - 3)/6]

⇒ 1/6

**∴ Required value of the question is 1/6.**
